translations.web: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
translations.bsb: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.
translations.kjv: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
translations.asv: and two chains of pure gold; like cords shalt thou make them, of wreathen work: and thou shalt put the wreathen chains on the settings.
